title: cyperus sanguinolentus subsp. melanocephalus
intro: Cyperus sanguinolentus subsp. melanocephalus, commonly known as Red Papyrus or Blackhead Sedge, is a plant species in the sedge family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus sanguinolentus subsp. melanocephalus include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce swelling, fight infections, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
